runs.title: 20 Oct 2026 · Dilution series · SYBR + LIDAR
runs.protocolNote: Operator-confirmed: A = vaccine 1:1,000; B = 1:100; C = 1:10; D = gBlock 1:20,000; E = NTC. TaqMan mix used 7.5 µl of each 10 µM probe and 15 µl of each 10 µM Prober. With 17 µl of the 510 µl mix in a 20 µl reaction, these give 125 nM each TaqMan probe and 250 nM each Prober. Original export labels are preserved separately. All rows contain mixed Spike/Ori assays. Column 12 is NTC in every row; F–H were not recorded. Filenames specify 95°C for 3 minutes with 0.5% Triton during treatment; final detergent concentration at each dilution is not independently confirmed. Primer remaking was planned but is not separately confirmed. These plates were acquired on different cyclers.
